name: No investor-account TM rules
description: No behavioural rules on investor deposit / refund patterns.

name: No PEP / sanctions screening on investors
description: Investors not screened at registration / on changes.

name: No project-owner DD
description: Project owner UBO not unwound; sanctions / PEP / adverse-media not screened.

name: No use-of-funds monitoring
description: No periodic check that funds raised are used as disclosed.

name: No ECSPR suitability / appropriateness
description: No knowledge / loss-bearing / appropriateness checks per ECSPR.

name: No secondary-market surveillance
description: If secondary market offered, no MAR-style surveillance on trading.
